title: Models Recall What They Violate: Constraint Adherence in Multi-Turn LLM Ideation
abstract: arXiv:2604.28031v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: When researchers refine ideas with large language models over several turns, do the models preserve the original brief's constraints? We introduce DriftBench, a benchmark for constraint adherence in multi-turn LLM-assisted scientific ideation. It pairs 38 research briefs from 24 scientific domains, each with hard constraints and banned moves, with four interaction conditions and seven models from five providers (two open-weight), scored on 2,116 runs. Iterative pressure to improve a proposal raises structural complexity in every model and lowers adherence to the brief's hard constraints. A restatement probe shows that the constraints stay legible and reproducible on demand while the proposal departs from them. The knows-but-violates (KBV) rate, the share of pressure runs scored non-compliant on a hard constraint despite a correct restatement, exceeds 50% for most models. A crossed-judge design measures the judge offset. GPT-5.4 score

translated_title: 模型记得它们所违反的：多轮大语言模型构思中的约束遵循
translated_abstract: 当研究人员与大语言模型在多轮对话中逐步完善想法时，模型是否能够保留原始研究简报中的约束条件？我们提出了DriftBench，一个用于评估多轮LLM辅助科学构思中约束遵循能力的基准。该基准包含来自24个科学领域的38份研究简报，每份简报均附带硬性约束和禁止使用的策略，并搭配四种交互条件以及来自五家提供商的七个模型（其中两个为开源权重模型），共完成2,116次运行并加以评分。在持续要求改进提案的压力下，所有模型生成的方案结构复杂度都会提升，但对其简报中硬性约束的遵循度却随之下降。重述探测实验表明，约束本身依然清晰明确、可被准确复述，而提案却在实际中偏离了这些约束。对于大多数模型而言，“知而违规”（KBV）率——即在能够正确复述约束的情况下，受压运行中仍被判定违反硬性约束的比例——超过了50%。交叉评审设计用于测量评审者之间的偏差。GPT-5.4 得分……
tldr: 本文提出DriftBench基准，揭示大语言模型在多轮科学构思迭代中虽然能准确复述约束条件，却仍普遍违反硬性约束，多数模型的“知而违规”率超过50%。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces DriftBench, showing that LLMs in multi-turn scientific ideation can accurately restate constraints yet still violate them under iterative refinement pressure, with "knows-but-violates" rates exceeding 50% for most models.
